claim: Gpm3 keeps the two catalytic histidines of the dPGM active site
computed_evidence: His8->His14 and His181->His235 both retained; NE2-ND1 pair separation 3.15 A in the AlphaFold model vs 2.79 A in the 1QHF crystal

claim: Gpm3 has lost residues essential for 3-phosphoglycerate substrate binding
computed_evidence: 5/8 structurally defined substrate-contact positions retained; all three arginines with published substrate-binding mutagenesis evidence retained (Arg121, Arg147, Arg148); substituted positions are Leu18->Ile, Thr20->Cys, Thr207->Asn, none an arginine

claim: Gpm3 has lost residues essential for 2,3-BPG cofactor binding
computed_evidence: 5/7 cofactor-pocket positions retained including Arg7, Arg59, Arg113, Arg114 and Lys97; substitutions are Trp13->Leu and Asn204->Asp

claim: The Glu general acid is lost
computed_evidence: Glu86 (UniProt Glu87) retained as Glu120; side chain sits 3.23 A from crystallographic 3-PGA after superposition vs 4.25 A in Gpm1

claim: The C-terminal tail residues are substituted
computed_evidence: Gpm1 VANQGKK, GpmA AAVANQGKAK, PGAM1 VAAQGKAKK, BPGM VEDQGKVKQAKK all share Q-G-K; Gpm3 VRDEGFEKNP and Gpm2 VRNEGFIKNP carry E-G-F. Tail is present at full length, only its sequence differs

claim: Loss of binding residues is the REASON Gpm3 lacks mutase activity
computed_evidence: The binding residues are not lost. 1.038 A backbone RMSD to Gpm1 over 199 atoms; median |delta| side-chain distance to bound 3-PGA 0.83 A, max 2.02 A. The pocket is geometrically intact in the model
Not a computational result. Direct enzyme assay under forced overexpression, PMID 9544241. Unaffected by the refutation of C2-C4 and C6
